message: Initialized AI Customer Support Agent workspace setup.
Scaffolded directory architecture, configured uv package manager and pre-commit hooks. Successfully ran linter and formatters, committed, and pushed feature branch to remote origin.
Implemented CRMDatabase, PolicyEngine, AgentState, tool logic, graph nodes, and strict conditional routing. Verified pre-commit validation and compiled LangGraph workflow topology.

Integrated MemorySaver checkpointer for state preservation. Built FastAPI WebSocket handler with real-time stream token and reasoning telemetry event parsing via .astream_events(version='v2'). Exposed a static REST API /api/crm/profiles for database visualization. Verified application compilation and clean Ruff styling.

Transitioned to monorepo structure by nesting python code under backend/ and created a Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v3 app under frontend/. Designed a twin-panel layout mapping token streams and live reasoning logs. Configured sessionStorage for client sessions and verified clean linting, type checks, and asset bundling.

Implemented DeepgramVoiceEngine supporting async real-time streaming STT and REST-based low-latency TTS. Integrated mixed text/binary WebSocket frame routing to stream microphone audio bytes, process with STT, invoke LangGraph refund audit evaluation flow, synthesize response with Deepgram Aura voice, and stream audio chunks back. Verified frontend browser capture and playback alignment, compiled cleanly, and passed automated Ruff lint/formatting checks.
